label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (S100A8/A9-high)
description: Cluster 0 is epithelial, leaning toward differentiated squamous cells. The lineage rests on squamous differentiation metagenes M69 (CRNN, KLK13, KRT23), M65 (KRT13, KRT4, PPL) and M28 (PI3, KRT24, TGM1), supported by top genes CRNN, KLK13, CLCA4, PI3, KRT24 and KLK10. Glandular/secretory genes (M20: MUC1, CEACAM7) and an epithelial tumor-like state (M32, M42) add to the epithelial signal. S100A8/S100A9 (M0, M28) carries a moderate inflammatory or neutrophil-like component, but no listed metagene is a clearly separate lineage above 5%, so no contaminant is called. Basal markers KRT5/KRT14 are absent, so this is not a basal layer.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Tumor epithelial cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Glandular secretory epithelium program

label: Low-quality cells, weak squamous signal
description: Cluster 1 (580 cells) is dominated by technical and diffuse factors: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, 14.9%), M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4 multi-copy families, 11.7%) and M45 (ubiquitous RNA-processing genes, 3.0%), and the top genes are OR4F17, IST1 and SIGLEC15. The only lineage-like signals are weak and not enriched: squamous differentiation M37 (1.6%, fold 2.5x, 6.6% of cells) and basal-like squamous M10 (1.5%, low confidence). Myeloid M14 is at background levels (1.9%, fold 1.1x), so there is no clear cell type and the cluster is probably low quality.

label: T cells (regulatory T cell-enriched)
description: Cluster 2 is a T-lymphocyte population. The core T-cell metagene M29 (CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, CD2, CD247, BCL11B) carries 11.2% of counts in 57% of cells, and the regulatory T-cell metagene M83 (FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT) carries 10.5% in 41% of cells, with top genes CTLA4 and TRAC. The cytotoxic CD8/NK metagene M93 is present in a smaller subset (24% of cells, 5% share), so the cluster is mainly CD4-leaning regulatory T cells with some CD8 cells. Stromal (M75) and other diffuse metagenes are background, with no meaningful foreign-lineage contamination.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells
metagene_label: T cell markers + Regulatory T cell markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (inflamed)
description: Cluster 3 is dominated by M37 (18.8% share, in 56% of cells, 79x fold), a squamous differentiation signature with cornification and granular genes (FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, KRT13). M15 (SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP, KLK10) and M69 (CRNN, KLK13, CNFN) add terminal squamous differentiation, and M0 and M70 add squamous epithelial genes with S100A8/A9. Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent, so this leans toward differentiated, superficial, inflamed squamous epithelium rather than basal cells. The S100A8/A9 signal sits within the cluster's own squamous metagenes and is treated as inflammation, not a separate lineage. Hypoxia (M11) is a secondary program.

label: Fibroblasts / stromal cells (low confidence)
description: Weak stromal signal: fibroblast ECM metagene M4 (4.1% share, 1.8x fold, 15% of cells; COL3A1, SFRP4, LUM, PDGFRA) with smaller smooth-muscle/myofibroblast M19 (4.0%, 2.6x) and stromal stress M75 (2.3%, low confidence). Top genes are mostly diffuse housekeeping (GNAS, NPM1, PTMA, TPT1), and the stromal metagenes are not dominant. No contamination from other lineages is evident. Fibroblast-like stroma is the best-supported identity, but the call is uncertain.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells, Stromal cells

label: B cells (germinal-center subset enriched)
description: Cluster 5 is a B-cell cluster. M34 (B cell markers: MS4A1, BANK1, BLK, CD79A, CD22, FCRL1, IRF8) holds 16.5% of counts and is present in 80.8% of cells, and the top genes (MS4A1, CD22, BANK1, BLK, CD79A, IRF8) agree. M33 (germinal-center program: CXCL13, CR2, GCSAM, AICDA, RGS13, FCER2, TCL1A) adds 6.4% and is enriched about 72-fold in a subset of about 13% of cells, so the cluster leans toward follicular/germinal-center B cells. Myeloid (M14, 2%) and stromal (M75, 1.9%) signal are small background and not called as contamination; the remaining metagenes are diffuse and non-lineage.
cell_types: B cells, Germinal center B cells

label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (S100A8/A9-high)
description: Squamous epithelial cells, mostly differentiated or suprabasal, with a basal component. Squamous differentiation metagenes M0, M5 and M6 (KRT13, DSP, DSG3, DSC2, SERPINB13) and the basal metagenes M1 and M26 (KRT5, TP63, KRT15) carry most of the signal, and the top genes (PERP, KRT13, KRT5, DSP, DSG3, CD24) are epithelial. S100A8/S100A9 sits inside the squamous metagene M0 rather than in a separate myeloid factor, so it is treated as the cluster's own inflammatory component, not contamination. A small cycling signal (M17) is present in a minority of cells.

label: Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling, smooth muscle-like signal)
description: Stromal cluster dominated by fibroblast ECM signal: M4 (fibroblast ECM markers, COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1, LUM, PDGFRA) carries 18.5% of counts in 70% of cells, and the top genes (SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1, COL6A2, COL5A1, LUM, COL1A2) are fibroblast genes. M38 (activated ECM-remodeling fibroblasts, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11) adds 6.1%, and M75 (stromal stress state) adds 3.2%. M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast, DES, ACTG2, MYH11, TAGLN) is a substantial 13.8% in 38% of cells, suggesting a smooth-muscle-like or myofibroblast component within the same mesenchymal lineage rather than a foreign lineage. Endothelial and immune markers are absent, so no contamination is called.
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma
refine_reason: Activated fibroblast identity used elsewhere as 'Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling)'; kept the smooth muscle-like signal as a qualifier.

label: Endothelial cells (+ pericyte signal)
description: Vascular endothelial cluster. M27 (endothelial, 22.2% share, in 66% of cells) leads, and the top genes are endothelial (VWF, PECAM1, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, KDR, MMRN1). M25 (pericyte-like, NOTCH3/RGS5, 18.1% share, in 72.5% of cells) is comparably large and present in most cells, but no pericyte genes such as NOTCH3 or RGS5 appear among the top genes, so it is most likely perivascular spillover or a sub-population signal rather than the cluster's own identity. Fibroblast metagenes (M38, M4) are minor, with shares of 2.9% or less.

label: Low-quality cells (weak stromal signal)
description: Cluster 9 has no clear lineage. Its largest shares come from technical or ambiguous metagenes: M30 (OR4F17/IST1-high, 13.1%, 25% of cells) and M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4-high, 10.4%), with M45, M56, M60 and M8 adding diffuse background. Stromal metagenes are weak: M4 fibroblast ECM at 3.2% (fold 1.4x), M19 smooth muscle/myofibroblast at 2.6%, and M27 endothelial at 1.3%, each in only a small fraction of cells. The top modeled genes are OR4F17, IST1, SIGLEC15, SMG1 and PDE4DIP, with no collagen or vascular genes among them, so the cluster is likely low-quality or background-dominated, with at most a faint mesenchymal component.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells, Endothelial cells

label: Low-quality cells (faint squamous epithelial signal)
description: Cluster 10 has no clear lineage. Its largest metagene is M10 (2.1% share, fold 1.4x), a basal-like squamous epithelial factor led by KRT15, ITGA2 and DSC3, but it is weak and present in only 4% of cells. Most of the counts sit in diffuse, low-specificity factors (M45, M30, M2, M56, M22, M60) that are largest in other clusters and have no coherent lineage theme; the top genes (OR4F17, IST1, SMG1, ZNG1A, SIGLEC15, ITCH, nuclear RNA-processing genes) match these background and probe-artifact factors. Lineage evidence is limited to M10 and the basal-like M74 (TP63/ITGB4/COL7A1), which is also weak. The cluster looks like low-quality or background-dominated cells with at most a faint squamous epithelial component.

label: T cells (+ fibroblast signal)
description: Cluster leans toward T lymphocytes: M29 (T cell core: CD3E, TRAC, GIMAP7, CD2) is the largest lineage metagene and is present in 28% of cells, with M83 (Treg: FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA) and M93 (CD8/cytotoxic: CD8A, GZMK, PRF1) adding subsets. The top genes are mostly T-lineage (TRAC, CD3E, GIMAP7, GIMAP4, CD52). Stromal metagenes M4 (fibroblast ECM, 3.8%), M19 (smooth muscle, 3.6%) and M75 (stromal stress, 1.8%) together make about 9% of counts, a moderate foreign signal likely from neighbouring stroma, with CCN2 and TAGLN among the top genes. Technical and ambiguous metagenes (M30, M2, M8) are diffuse background.
cell_types: T cells, CD8 cytotoxic T cells, Regulatory T cells

label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (inflamed, weak)
description: Cluster 12 is small (279 cells) and lacks a dominant lineage. Its strongest identity signals are weak squamous/keratinocyte features: M0 (differentiated squamous epithelium with S100A8/A9, 1.6x enriched), M15 (cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KLK10, 2.5x) and M5 (desmosomal/squamous genes), and top genes IVL and SERPINB4-like keratinocyte genes. Much of the cluster is taken up by technical or nonspecific factors (M30 OR4F17/IST1 at 12.7%, M2 at 9.8%) and inflammatory/stress programs (M36, M35, M49, M11), which add a qualifier but no lineage. The squamous signal is modest and not clearly dominant, so the call is tentative, favoring differentiated squamous epithelial (tumor) cells with an inflammatory component.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Differentiated keratinocytes, Tumor cells
refine_reason: Differentiated squamous epithelium wording differs from the 'Differentiated squamous epithelial cells' family; harmonized and kept the weak-signal qualifier.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (hypoxia/stress state)
description: A small cluster of squamous epithelial cells. The largest share comes from M6, a differentiated squamous program (SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, DSC2, CTNND1, MUC4) with a hypoxia/stress add-on (BHLHE40, SLC2A1, NDRG1). Basal keratinocyte metagenes M26 (KRT15, TP63, ITGA6, ITGB4) and M80 (TP63, COL17A1, LAMB3) add a basal-like component, and M20 (MUC1, CEACAM7, KLK10, TMPRSS2) adds a secretory epithelial signal at about 5%. No foreign lineage is clearly present. The genes are diffuse and KRT5/KRT14 are not in the core factors, so the call is only moderately supported.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling)
description: Small cluster of 45 cells whose lineage signal is fibroblastic. The main fibroblast ECM factor M4 (11.5% share, 5.1x fold, top genes COL3A1, COL6A1, SFRP1/4, LUM, TNC) is the largest identity metagene, with activated ECM-remodeling M38 (COL3A1, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11) and smooth muscle-like add-on M19 (DES, MYH11, TAGLN) supporting a cancer-associated stromal state. Technical/ambiguous factors M30 (OR4F17) and M2 dominate about 30% of counts and carry no lineage. Plasma cell (M3), squamous (M37) and CD8/NK (M93) shares are each around 1-2%, so they are background rather than contamination.
cell_types: Cancer-associated fibroblasts, Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle-like stroma
refine_reason: Activated fibroblast identity worded differently from the shared 'Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling)' label.

label: Fibroblasts (weak, diffuse signal)
description: Small cluster of 36 cells whose modeled counts are mostly diffuse housekeeping and ER/NF-kB program signal, with no dominant lineage. The most identifiable lineage is fibroblast-like stroma: M4 (fibroblast ECM, 7.0% share, fold 3.1x) and top genes SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1 and COL6A1. Foreign lineage signal is small and background-level: Treg M83 (4.2%), endothelial M27 (4.0%) and smooth muscle M19 (3.2%). Because M4 is present in only about 11% of cells and the lineage shares are low, the identity call is weak.
contaminants: Regulatory T cells (minor, ~4%), Endothelial cells (minor, ~4%), Smooth muscle (minor, ~3%)

label: Basal squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 16 is a basal/reserve squamous epithelial population. The lineage comes from M1 (basal squamous epithelial cells, KRT5, TP63, DSP, 9.1% share, 5.0x fold) with support from M26 (basal keratinocyte program, KRT15, ITGA6, ITGB4, LAMB3), M10 (KRT15, ITGA2, DSC3), M80 (TP63, COL17A1, CYP24A1, IL1R2) and M5 (DSP, KRT13, PKP1). The top genes KRT15, TP63, ITGB4, ITGA2, LAMB3, CYP24A1 and IL1R2 agree. Several metagenes are diffuse, and the lineage signal is partial. S-phase (M17, 3.1%) is minor and does not change the identity. No foreign lineage metagene reaches contamination levels.
cell_types: Basal squamous epithelial cells, Basal-like tumor epithelial cells

label: Glandular epithelium/fibroblast mixture
description: A small, low-confidence mixed cluster. The glandular secretory epithelial add-on M20 (6.2% share, in a third of cells; MUC1, CEACAM7, LYPD2, TMPRSS2, PRSS22 among the top genes) is about as large as the stromal signal, which is fibroblast ECM M4 (5.2%) plus activated fibroblast M38 (3.7%; COL3A1, COL6A1, COL6A2, COL5A1 are top genes). The epithelial call rests on an add-on module without core EPCAM/KRT8/CDH1 weight, so it could be tumor epithelium or a stress/secretory state. Minor squamous (M37), B-cell (M34) and endothelial (M27) signals are each under about 3% and are background, and the diffuse technical metagenes (M2, M30, M68) do not define identity.
metagene_label: Glandular secretory epithelium program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Cycling squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 18 is dominated by proliferation: cycling programs M7 (8.5%, histone and mitotic genes), M17 (7.3%, S-phase), M24, M39 and M41 together make up about 24% of counts, and the top genes are H1-5, H3C2, TPX2, MKI67, TOP2A and CENPF. The squamous lineage is the cluster's own identity, carried by basal squamous metagene M1 (6.0%, KRT5, TP63, DSP) and the squamous add-on M5 (3.3%, DSP, DSC3, KRT13), with weaker support from M74 and M12. The lineage call is medium confidence because the squamous markers are modest and diffuse, and the cells are not clearly one cell type. No substantial foreign lineage is present; the S100A8/9 signal in M12 is weak.
cell_types: Cycling squamous epithelial cells, Basal squamous epithelial cells, Cervical tumor cells

label: Regulatory T cells (CD4+ T cell-like)
description: Cluster dominated by T-lineage signal: M83 (Treg markers FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT) is the largest lineage metagene at 7.2% share, supported by M29 (CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, BCL11B) at 3.3% and M93 (CD8/cytotoxic) at 1.6%. Top genes CTLA4, TRAC, CD3E, TRBC1 and TRBC2 confirm the T cell identity, with a regulatory bias. Much of the counts sit in diffuse, low-specificity ambiguous metagenes (M30, M2, M8), which do not change the call. Fibroblast (M4) and myeloid (M14) signals are small, about 3% and 2%, and are treated as background.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, T cells

label: Tumor-associated macrophages (cDC2-like subset)
description: Myeloid-dominated cluster. M14 (myeloid, CLEC10A/FCGR2A-high, 22.1% share, 39x fold) and M59 (tumor-associated macrophages, 7.8% share, 38.8x fold) together make up about 30% of counts. The top genes are macrophage-type (C1QA, C1QC, MMP9, APOE, CD14, CSF1R, STAB1, FCER1G), with CLEC10A/FGL2 signal from M14 suggesting a cDC2-like or inflammatory monocyte-derived subset. Epithelial (M1) and other metagenes are minor background and not treated as contamination.
cell_types: Tumor-associated macrophages, Myeloid cells, Dendritic cells

label: Fibroblasts (+ endothelial signal)
description: Small cluster (34 cells) whose own identity is stromal fibroblast: M4 (fibroblast ECM, 6.5%) and M38 (activated/ECM-remodeling fibroblast, 5.1%) together with M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast stroma, 3.3%) carry the largest share, and top genes COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, SFRP4 and COL4A1 agree. Endothelial M27 (6.0%, fold 10.2x) with VWF among the top genes is a comparable secondary signal, likely present in a subset of cells. IFN-gamma program M49 (8.7%, with CXCL9/10, STAT1, GBP1) is a shared inflammatory program, not a lineage. CD8/NK metagene M93 (3.7%) is in about 12% of cells, which is background or a few doublets rather than the cluster's identity.

label: Inflamed squamous epithelial cells (low quality)
description: Small cluster (36 cells) dominated by diffuse background metagenes (M45, M64, M86, M43, M84 and others, together over 50% of counts) with no clear lineage. The most informative identity signal is squamous: M37 (squamous differentiation with S100A8/ERO1A, 6.0% share, 9.2x fold) and M0 (differentiated squamous epithelium, 4.3%) together with CRNN, CRCT1, KRT13 and ECM1 among the top genes. M59 (tumor-associated macrophages, 3.1%, 5.0x fold) is a modest foreign signal in about 8% of cells, which is contamination-level. Proliferation (M17, 7.5%) and minor fibroblast (M38, 2%) signals are weak. Confidence is low because the cluster is mostly background.

label: Fibroblasts (+ macrophage signal)
description: Small cluster (40 cells) whose identity rests on stromal signal. The fibroblast ECM factor M4 (10.1% share, in 10% of cells) and the activated/cancer-associated fibroblast factor M38 (2.2%) carry COL3A1, COL6A1, SFRP1/4 and POSTN, pointing to fibroblasts. A macrophage factor M59 (7.3% share, fold 11.6x, largest in cluster 20) is present in only about 2.5% of cells, suggesting a doublet-like subset or spillover rather than the cluster's own identity. T cell (M29), IgG plasma cell (M3) and squamous (M0, M37) factors are minor, and diffuse background factors (M58, M64) take a large share with no lineage.

label: Fibroblasts (+ CD8 T cell signal)
description: Cluster 24 is a small fibroblast-like cluster. M4 (fibroblast ECM markers) is the largest lineage metagene at 11.2% share and is enriched 5.0x. Its top genes are COL3A1, SFRP1, SFRP4, COL6A1, TNC, COL5A1 and IGF1, and the cluster's top genes agree. Lymphoid signal is present but minor: M93 (CD8 cytotoxic T/NK, 5.4%, in 2.6% of cells) and M29 (T cell markers, 4.2%) are likely from a small subset of doublets or spillover, as CST7 and CD8A are among the top genes. Most of the remaining counts sit in diffuse, low-specificity metagenes, so the call is moderately uncertain.

label: Plasma cells (IgG-high, ER stress program)
description: Cluster 25 is dominated by plasma cell signatures: M3 (IgG plasma cell markers, 14.1% share, in 54% of cells) and M31 (plasma cell immunoglobulin program, 5.8%) together with M23 (IgG plasma cell markers, 1.8%), with top genes IGHG1, IGHG2, IGKC, IGHG3, IGLC7, MZB1, XBP1, DERL3 and POU2AF1 all strongly enriched. B-cell (MS4A1, CD19) and T-cell (CD3E) markers are absent. M53 (ER stress/UPR, 24.9% share, in 80% of cells) is a program that sits on top of the plasma cell identity rather than defining it. Fibroblast signal (M4, 3.1%) is small and not foreign enough to call contamination; the remaining metagenes (M8, M79, M60, M13) are diffuse technical or ambiguous background.
metagene_label: ER stress unfolded protein response + IgG plasma cell markers

label: Fibroblasts (smooth muscle-like stroma)
description: Stromal cluster led by smooth muscle/myofibroblast metagene M19 (13.9% share, 9.2x fold) with fibroblast ECM metagenes M4 (6.0%) and activated fibroblast M38 (5.5%). Top genes CCN2, SFRP4, COL3A1, TAGLN, GREM1, THBS1, MYLK and COL6A1 fit activated fibroblasts with a smooth muscle-like component. M29 T cell signal (7.4% share, in about 2 of 35 cells) is a modest foreign lineage, most likely doublets or spillover, and is listed as contamination.

label: Squamous epithelium, NF-kB inflamed (+ T cell signal)
description: Small cluster of 50 cells whose strongest signal is an NF-kB/TNF inflammatory program (M36, 12.3% share, 16x fold; TNFAIP2 is the top gene). The lineage is best supported by squamous epithelial metagenes: M69 (CRNN-high, KLK13, KRT23), M37 (FLG, CRNN, IVL, with S100A8 and ERO1A) and M5 (DSP, KRT13, SERPINB4), together about 9% of counts with 4-6x fold. Basal markers (KRT5/KRT14) are not in this cluster's leading metagenes. Lymphoid signal is modest: T-cell M29 (4%) and CD8/NK cytotoxic M93 (2%) sum to about 6%, which fits spillover or a minor doublet contribution, so it is listed as contamination and not used for identity.
contaminants: T cells, CD8 cytotoxic T/NK cells

label: Activated fibroblasts (+ minor plasma cells)

A smaller plasma cell signal (M3 IgG plasma cell markers 3.3%, M31 1.6% combined with IGHG1 among top genes) is present in a few cells and is likely a minor admixture or bleed rather than a major lineage. Squamous (M37, 4.5%) and myeloid/TAM signals (M59, M14) are small and not contamination worth listing.

label: Squamous epithelial cells, inflamed (+ stromal signal)

Basal markers KRT5/KRT14 are absent, so the call is a superficial squamous layer. Stromal signal is present at about 11% (M19 smooth muscle, M4 fibroblast ECM, with SFRP4, COL3A1, CCN2, TAGLN), and T/NK signal at about 7% (M83 Treg, M93 CD8 cytotoxic), most likely contamination or spillover from neighboring stroma and lymphocytes. Most of the remaining share is diffuse background metagenes.

label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (inflamed, hypoxic)
description: Small cluster (32 cells) defined by a squamous differentiation/cornification signature: M37 (7.5% share, 11.6x fold) and M15 (cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP, KLK7) together with M6 and M0, and top genes ERO1A, IVL, CRNN, FLG and CRCT1. S100A8/A9 and hypoxia genes (M37, M6) add an inflamed, hypoxic flavour, and basal markers KRT5/KRT14 are absent from this cluster's modeled genes. The fibroblast metagene M4 (3.5%) is below the contamination threshold and is treated as background. IGHG1 is a top gene but no plasma metagene is enriched, so it is not called as contamination. description: Small cluster of 30 cells whose own identity is differentiated squamous epithelium: M37 (squamous differentiation, 12.4% share, FLG/CRNN/CRCT1/IVL) and M15 (cornification genes, IVL/SBSN/TGM1/KRTDAP) lead, and the top genes (FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, SCEL, IL36A) agree. Foreign signal is moderate: T-cell metagene M29 (7.2%, largest in cluster 2) and fibroblast ECM metagene M4 (6.2%, largest in cluster 33) are present in roughly 10-13% of cells, consistent with contamination or spillover rather than a mixed identity. Plasma cell M3 (1.6%) is background and ignored.

The top genes agree (FLG 9.5x, CRNN 2.7x, ERO1A 5.1x). Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent, so the call is a superficial keratinizing squamous state rather than basal cells. M29 (T cell markers) is only 4.1% of counts, below the contamination threshold, and is noted but not treated as contamination. Most of the cluster's counts are unassigned background, so the call is weak.
